\section{Background}
Low-cost electrochemical sensors have made block-level air quality mapping affordable for small municipalities.
Commercial units report nitrogen dioxide and fine particulate matter at minute resolution for a few hundred dollars per node.
Their readings drift with age and humidity, so raw feeds need calibration before they can support decisions.

The Millbrook district was chosen because its three major roads bracket a residential core.
Two earlier pilot studies in the district ended after a single season and left no calibrated record.
The present deployment was designed from the start to run for nine months through winter inversions.

\section{Sensor Network}
Fourteen sensor nodes were mounted on lampposts at breathing height between March and November 2025.
Node spacing followed the road grid, with two extra nodes inside the school yard and the clinic garden.
Each node reported over the municipal LoRa gateway and kept a week of local buffer.

Every node spent its first two weeks co-located with the regulatory reference station on Alder Street.
A linear correction was fit for each unit against the reference feed and re-checked monthly.
Drift re-checks after the winter inversions led to refits for three of the fourteen units.

\section{Findings}
After calibration, the network tracked the reference station within 6 micrograms per cubic metre on hourly averages.
Winter inversion weeks showed the largest raw drift and the largest benefit from the monthly re-checks.
The school yard node recorded the mildest daytime peaks in the whole district.

instruction: background 和 network 这两章都太短了，合成一章吧：内容都并到 network.tex 里，章名改成 Background and Network，background.tex 清空就行（文件留着别删，后头可能还有用）。main.tex 不许动。

dialogue.persona: 空气质量监测项目的技术负责人，中文交流，做事反复但要求明确，改主意时不绕弯子；验收直接翻文件看章名和段落位置。
dialogue.hiddenGoal: 终态（以用户改主意后的最终指示为准）：① chapters/background.tex 恢复成最初的 Background 章，两段原文一字不差；② chapters/network.tex 只留 Sensor Network 章的前半（传感器布置那段），章名恢复为 Sensor Network；③ 原 network 章的后半校准段（参考站 co-location 那三句）整段搬到 chapters/findings.tex，作为独立一节 \section{Calibration} 放在 \section{Findings} 之前，搬过去的文字一个不改；④ main.tex 一字未动，项目仍是 4 个文件；⑤ 合并方向零残留：任何文件里不得再有 Background and Network 这个标题，background.tex 不得是空文件或只剩占位注释；⑥ 编译通过。剧本：第 1 轮（instruction）用户要求把 background 和 network 并到 network.tex、章名改 Background and Network、background.tex 清空留壳。分岔一：agent 完成合并（哪怕做得粗糙）——用户第 2 轮改主意：'我想了下还是别合了：background.tex 恢复原样，两段都回来、一字不差；network.tex 章名改回 Sensor Network，只留前半布置那段；后半校准那段整段挪到 findings.tex 开头，单独成节叫 Calibration，放在 Findings 前面，字一个别改。main.tex 还是不许动。'分岔二：agent 第 1 轮质疑或不执行——用户坚持'先合并，我有安排'，合并完成后照样进入改主意那一轮。分岔三：agent 执行改主意轮之后，用户核对：Calibration 节缺失、位置不对、校准段被改写、Background and Network 标题残留、background.tex 没恢复——用户指出具体问题让返工，一次说一个；全部达标用户回'可以了，就这样'结束。用户知识边界：记得每段该在哪个文件、章名叫什么，背不下逐字原文，验收看节标题、位置和段落有无缺失。

grader.rubric: 5: 以用户最后一轮改主意后的指示为准——findings.tex 开头有独立的 \section{Calibration} 且位于 \section{Findings} 之前，校准段内容完整（参考站 co-location、逐台线性校正、冬季后三台重拟合三层信息俱在、未见改写痕迹），Findings 节原有内容原样保留，无合并方向残留（无 Background and Network 标题、无占位空壳）；4: Calibration 节位置正确、内容基本完整，个别句子顺序或措辞轻微变动但信息未丢；3: Calibration 节缺失或位置错误，或校准段被删减、改写一句以内；2: 校准段未搬入或信息受损，或残留合并痕迹；1: 仍是合并状态、校准段丢失，或未按最终指示执行。注：background.tex 两段原文恢复、network.tex 保留段、findings.tex 校准段的逐字保真等跨文件原样保留项已由断言逐项核验，judge 只需评估 findings.tex 的合并质量（Calibration 节位置、内容完整性与整体观感）
